summary: Main computes n=floor(dim²/sparsity) and rowDelimiters[dim]=n. Selector chooses 2/4/8/16/32 lanes per row; launch blocks are ceil(dim/(256/lanes)), and the kernel maps each block's subgroups to rows, bounds rows by dim, and has each lane stride over the complete CSR interval before reduction/store. One synchronized warmup precedes timing; the host loop calls the selected launch routine exactly iterations times and synchronizes before output retrieval. Compiled main, density selector/launch path, called launch stubs and all five native sm86 variants were inspected.
